trap-nonspeakable.notes: TWO RIGOR FLAGS. (1) CONTRADICTION WITH THE SAME CHAPTER: Step 1 asserts the Markov trace is non-degenerate because 'every $y_\lambda(q) \neq 0$', giving 'a strictly positive linear combination of characters'. Under the canonical convention D that is false at n=3: prop:frobenius-gram-matrix and rem:frobenius-gram-matrix-context in this chapter state y_{(1^3)} = 0 exactly, the (1^3) block lies in the radical, and det G = 0 identically (I reproduced det G = 0 and the null eigenvalue independently). Step 1 and Step 2's isomorphism Phi_tau are therefore convention-C statements; under D they hold on H_n/rad tr_M only. The whole chain (Steps 1-5, both corollaries) inherits this. Fix: state the non-degeneracy hypothesis with its convention, and read Phi_tau on the quotient. Note tau(1) = sum_lambda d_lambda y_lambda = 1 is correct in either convention — it is the STRICT positivity that fails. (2) Broken cross-reference: the final parenthetical '(see / mass-formula-iterative-lp-dual)' is a bare label on its own line with no markdown link, unlike every other reference in the block — link stripped.
